correctness.rationale: For H(z)=z^n+sA overline(z)+B with n>=2 and independent standard circular complex Gaussian A,B, the critical circle of f_n(z)=z^n+overline(z) has radius r_n=n^(-1/(n-1)). The inequality |z^n-w^n|<|z-w| for distinct interior disk points gives at most one reversing preimage, and winding/degree n yields exactly n+2 roots when the effective Gaussian target is in the hypocycloid and n otherwise. Polar-angle monotonicity W_n=n(n-1)(1-cos u)/(n²+2n cos u+1) proves a one-valued radial boundary, hence one random crossing T_n=(|B|/rho_n(Theta))^(1/q_n)/|A|. Independent Rayleigh/exponential integration gives the exact p_n(s) and Mellin strip -2q_n<p<2; Green-residue area and inertia supply small-s coefficients, and moment Taylor supplies large-s coefficients. Expanding q_n=1+1/n+O(n^-2), log rho²=(-2 log n+2 cos u)/n+O(log n/n²), weighted polar Jacobian W_n=(1-cos u)+O(n^-1) and the gamma logarithmic integral gives p_n(s)=s²/(1+s²)-s²[2 log n+EulerGamma+log(1+s^-2)]/[n(1+s²)²]+O_delta,Delta(log²(n)/n²), uniformly on each compact positive coupling interval. Boundary n=2 and s->0/infinity and exclusion of singular threshold respected.
